Commentary.Commentary: The expected news has come. INDIA HAVE DECLARED. So, the target is 459 for Bangladesh with four sessions left in the game. A very big task for the tourists although they should feel confident looking at the pitch that has remained decent so far. Join us in a while for the final session.

Quite the ideal session for the Indians. The openers departed cheaply but Pujara and Kohli batted fluently as did Rahane as the lead for India motored past the 450-run mark with aggressive batting. The intent was there by India's batsmen from the start. Taskin bowled well with the new ball while Shakib was comparatively better than his first innings.
Full and on the pads, goes across and clips it down towards fine leg for a brace. THAT SHALL BE TEA ON DAY 4.
12th Test fifty for Pujara.
FOUR! Good shot! Flatter outside off, sits on the back foot and essays a lovely late cut towards third man fence for a boundary. Pujara's excellent home season continues.
Sloppy fielding! Floated around off, uses his feet and drives it firmly towards mid on where Taijul fumbles to let the ball towards the deep. Brace taken.
On a length outside off, Jadeja was winding up for the big slog but the length wasn't quite there. Tapped with soft hands behind point for a single. Lead is now 450.
Floated on middle, uses his feet and tickles it towards short fine leg for a single.
Full and wide outside off, eases it towards cover-point for a single.
Tossed up outside off, leans forward and taps it towards short cover for a sharp single.
Floated outside off, reaches out and eases it down to long on for a single.
Flatter outside off, gets back and pushes it down to long on for a single.
Low full toss on leg stump, swept away towards deep backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Floated around off, Pujara uses his feet and whips it away past short mid-wicket to find the fence. Good use of the feet.
Flatter outside off, makes room and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Flatter outside off, stays back and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller on middle, gets across and works it to the leg side.
SIX! SMASHED! Floated around off, Jadeja goes across to that one and lifts it high over long on for a huge maximum. That was a meaty blow from the all-rounder. The lead is now 437.

FOUR! DROPPED! Mehedi has made a mess of a simple chance. Tossed up ball around off, Jadeja goes for the slog sweep but mistimes it high towards deep mid-wicket. Mehedi isn't balanced as goes for the catch and ends up parrying it past the ropes.
A bit short outside off, stays back and punches it firmly towards short cover.
RAVINDRA JADEJA gets a batting promotion, clearly showing that the declaration is just around the corner.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Another batsman perishes for the team's cause! Floated around off, Rahane steps out to play the wild slog but misses it altogether and finds the stumps disturbed. The lead is now 427.
Tossed up around off, goes across to sweep but gets a top edge. First slip anticipates it and moves towards the leg slip region but the ball goes well over him to the deep. Brace taken.
Fuller outside off, Pujara gets well across to try the cheeky paddle and is struck on the front pad.
Looped up on middle, uses his feet and mistimes the heave down to long on. Single taken.
Flatter outside off, Rahane makes room and slashes it over backward point for a couple.
ALMOST CARRIED! Flighted on middle, Rahane steps out for the big shot but then decides to check the shot. Nearly spooned a return catch towards Mehedi.
Flatter outside off, sits back and slaps it down the ground to long on for a single.
Fuller on middle, Pujara goes for the sweep but cannot get it past the fielder at backward square leg.
Tossed up on middle, steps out and digs it out to short mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, leans forward and defends it on to the track.
Flatter outside off, sits back to that one and defends well.
Tossed up on off, worked away to the leg side
Flatter on middle, gets back and nudges it towards short mid-wicket for a quick single.
Looped up well outside off, steps out and works it past square leg for a single.
Flighted outside off, pushed gently back to the bowler.
Fuller outside off, Rahane looks to work it away but gets a soft leading edge to the bowler.
Flatter outside off, stays back to cut but gets a bottom edge towards point.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks it well.
SIX! That's been smashed! Declaration batting is on now. Floated ball on the stumps, Rahane steps out to that one and clobbers it way over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Fuller outside off, reaches out and defends well.
On a length outside off, pushed towards the off side for a single. The throw at the keeper's end might have made things interesting but it is towards the wrong end.
Tossed up outside off, leans forward and chips it uppishly towards short cover.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and blocks solidly.
Floated on a length outside off, stays back and pushes it towards cover.
FOUR! SLAMMED! Floated on middle, Rahane goes for the slog sweep over mid-wicket. Made clean connection and the ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Fuller on the pads, tucked down to fine leg for a single.
Flatter outside off, sits back and defends it towards the covers.
Fuller on middle, leans across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, reaches out and blocks it to cover.
Drifting in from outside off, gets across to sweep but is hit on the pads as it goes past the keeper. Mild appeal for lbw but impact was outside the line. They take a leg bye.
Floated on a length on leg stump, stays back and powers it to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, leans across and drives it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! HAMMERED! Drags it short on off, Rahane goes back and pulls it away to the deep square leg fence for a boundary. Lead crosses 400.
Floated on middle and leg, Pujara gets across to paddle it in a premeditated manner. The ball goes off Rahim's pads to the leg side for a single.
Fuller and around off, worked towards mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, steps out to that one and works it to the leg side for a single.
Flatter outside off, sits back and whips it past mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, reaches out and pushes it towards point.
Flatter outside off, stays back and cuts it away on the off side for a single.
Fuller outside off, steps out to that one and blocks well.
Flatter on a length on off, stays back to pull but mistimes it towards the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, leans into it and defends solidly.
Flighted outside off, Pujara skips down the track and pats it back to the bowler.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and defends solidly.
Floated outside off, defended solidly from the crease.
Fuller on middle, leans forward and works it towards short mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, Rahane pushes at it but is beaten as that shapes away.

DROPPED! Sharp chance but you expect these to be taken at this level. Floated outside off, Rahane steps out to take it on the full and checks his drive. It goes back towards Shakib who stretches his right hand but the ball doesn't stick as the ball goes towards mid on.
Fuller on middle, gets across and works it to the leg side. Sharp single taken and he had to really hurry.
Floated outside off, skips down the track and powers it down to long on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, uses his feet and nudges it to the leg side.
Fuller outside off, leans across and drives it down to long on for a single.
Fuller and outside off, leans into it and defends it well.
On a length outside off, stays back and slaps it past point for a brace.
Tossed up outside off, presses forward to that one and blocks it on to the track.
Flatter on a length on middle, whipped off the back foot past mid-wicket for a single.
AJINKYA RAHANE is the new man in.

OUT! SHAKIB HAS HIS REVENGE! Floated on middle, Kohli steps out to repeat his earlier big shot over short mid-wicket. Didn't quite connect well enough and Mahmudullah takes a sharp catch. Kohli departs in pursuit of quick runs. INDIA LEAD BY 389.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Flatter on middle and leg, Kohli misses the sweep and is struck on the pads. Stifled lbw appeal but that was missing leg.

SIX! LAUNCHED! Flighted on middle, waltzes down the track and whips it over deep mid-wicket for a flat maximum. Absolute contempt from the Indian captain. They are checking if it is a boundary or a maximum and replays confirm that it did clear the ropes.
Flighted outside off, leans forward and thumps it to short extra cover where Mehedi makes a very good stop.
Tossed up outside off, Pujara gets forward to block but is struck on the pad well outside the line.
Floated outside off, leans forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
On a length outside off, Kohli waits and delays the cut nicely towards third man. Good running and the batsmen get three more.
Tossed up outside off, presses forward to that one and pushes it towards cover.
Flatter well outside off, no shot offered to that one by VK.
On a length outside off, Kohli rocks back to cut but is beaten as that skids off the deck.
MEHEDI HASAN comes on to bowl.
Flatter on a length on leg stump, stays back and whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Looped up from outside off, Kohli lunges into it and blocks.
Tossed up on middle and off, Pujara gets across and works it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up on off, leans forward and nudges it to the leg side.
Flatter on middle, leans across and works it to short mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, driven firmly down the ground to long off for a single.
Drinks break...
50-run stand between Pujara and Kohli.

SIX! Short ball again for Pujara, he goes for a pull shot. The ball finds the middle of the bat and goes all the way for a maximum. He is setting the tone too unlike his usual game. India lead by 377 runs ahead.
Short again and Kohli pulls it towards deep square leg for a single. They are going at a run rate of 5.53 runs per over.
FOUR! WHACKED! Wide outside off and Virat has a crack at it. He uppishly thrashes it over the extra cover region for a boundary. Seems like he is in the ODI mood.
Short into the body, Pujara sways away and plays the upper cut over the keeper's head. The fielder from third man cuts it off and the batsmen only manage to pick up a single.
Short delivery outside off, Kohli dabs it on the off side for a quick single.
Short delivery into the body, Pujara with an unorthodox pull towards deep square leg for a single.
Full delivery and Kohli flicks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Kohli lunges forward to defend it.
Down the leg side, Virat goes to clip it but gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire says no. Rahim and Shakib think of a review but decide not to take it.
On the pads, Pujara nudges it on the leg side and scampers through for a quick single.
Short into the pads, Kohli flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Floated up, Kohli pushes it towards the fielder at short cover.
Shakib Al Hasan will replace Taijul Islam.
Short into the body, hurried in a bit. Kohli stands tall and tries to defend it but the ball hits high on the bat and goes towards gully.
Short but this time down the leg side. Kohli sits down and lets it through.
Again short into the body and Pujara pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery which stops in, Pujara somehow manages to defend it.
FOUR! SUBLIME! Full and outside off, Pujara drives it elegantly through the extra cover region for a boundary. Terrific batting by the Indians.
Short into the body, Kohli pulls hard at it but this time straight to the fielder in front of square leg for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. 9 runs of the last over.
Floated in the line of the stumps, Pujara defends it really well.
Full on the pads, Kohli clips it through mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Outside off, Kohli cuts it really fine and late on the off side to guide it towards third man for a boundary. India lead by 350 runs.
On the pads, Kohli clips it fine down the leg side for an easy couple. Those two runs bring up the 50 runs on the board for India.
Full and wide outside off, Kohli slaps it towards wide of the fielder at sweeper cover. The batsmen run a couple there.
Fuller outside off, Pujara goes to hit it too hard but just manages to drive it towards the fielder at mid on.
Good length delivery outside off, Pujara stays in his crease and dabs it towards point. Calls for a single but he is sent back by Kohli.
FOUR! NO NEED TO RUN! Full on the stumps, Pujara just drives it straight down the ground through the mid on region for a boundary. No chase would have worked there.
Short and outside off, Kohli tries to slash it and he gets the upper half of the bat and the ball goes towards the fielder at sweeper cover for a single.
Angled into the pads, Virat leans forward and clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Short and wide outside off, Pujara guides it just wide of the slip fielder. Sabbir cuts it off as he is running from third man. The batsman just take a single.
Kohli lunges forward and defends it towards the fielder at covers.
On the pads, Kohli clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
LUCKY KOHLI! Tossed up outside off, Kohli lunges forward to defend but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Floated outside off, Kohli lunges forward and drives it through covers. The batsmen have run a couple.
Short outside off, Pujara cuts it one bounce over the slip fielder. A single is taken.
Angling in from outside off, Kohli camps back and punches it through the cover region. They take a single.
FOUR! PRECISION! Back of a length delivery outside off, Pujara stays deep in his crease and just opens his face of the bat to guide it through the gully region for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, Pujara covers his stumps and lets it through to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, Kohli cuts it late through the point region. A single is taken.
Full length delivery outside off, Kohli gets his inner half of the bat and pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR Leg byes! Short into the body catches Kohli by surprise. He does not hold back and goes for the pull but he misses. The ball hits the helmet and goes over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Kohli shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller on the stumps, Pujara has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On the pads, Pujara clips it on the leg side.
Short into the stumps, Pujara pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated up in the line of the stumps, Pujara walks down the track and drives it towards covers.
Angling in from outside off, Pujara has his defence well in place.
Tossed up, Pujara lunges forward in defence.
Fuller delivery outside off, Kohli drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
A pitch short and the ball skids after pitching outside off, Kohli goes for a cut but he misses.
Skipper Virat Kohli walks out. The whole crowd are up on their feet applauding.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Good length delivery outside off, Rahul stays in his crease and goes slashing at it. He finds an outside edge which goes straight into the gloves of Rahim. The players appeal and the umpire has raised his finger. The umpire still goes upstairs to check if its a front foot no ball. But again he is just safe and Rahul has to walk back. Two in two overs for Taskin.
Fuller into the stumps, Lokesh drives it elegantly towards the fielder at mid off.
FOUR! POWERFUL! Length delivery outside off, Rahul slashes and he slashes really hard at it. The ball goes through the point region for a boundary on the bounce.
Fuller delivery outside off, Rahul drives it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Again sprayed down the leg side, Rahul plays it through square leg for a single.
Rahul dances down the track and blocks the ball.
Down the leg side, Pujara clips it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Floated up outside off, Pujara dances down the track and drives it elegantly through the cover region for a boundary. First runs for Pujara.
Tossed up, Rahul drives it towards short covers and the fielder parries it towards mid off for a single.
Tossed up, Rahul lunges forward to defend it.
Length ball into the stumps, Pujara stays in his crease to defend it.
Cheteshwar Pujara will bat at number 3.

OUT! VIJAY DEPARTS! Short and wide outside off, Vijay has a slash at it as the ball goes to the keeper. The players appeal in unison and the umpire stays put. Wait! Vijay has started walking. The umpire calls him and goes upstairs to check the front foot. Replays show that it is a fair delivery and the umpire has raised his finger. There was a mild edge there and Taskin has drawn first blood in the process.
Short and outside off, Vijay sways away from the line of the delivery.
Full toss outside off, Rahul tries to drive it but he finds the inner half of the bat and the ball goes through the mid-wicket region. They pick up three runs in the process.
On a good length outside off, left alone.
Good length delivery outside off which keeps low, Rahul lets it through to the keeper.
Darted on the stumps, Rahul drives it through the mid on region. He keeps strike with that single.
Outside off, Lokesh camps back and pushes it towards the fielder at point.
Tossed up outside off, Rahul reaches to the pitch of the ball to block it.
Floated up, Rahul lunges into it and defends it.
Short outside off, Vijay pushes it through covers. The batsmen take a single.
FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Drifting on the pads, Vijay has put that away. He has clipped it beautifully through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Taijul Islam will bowl from the other end.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahul stays in his crease and lets that go straight to the keeper.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Vijay stays in his crease and pushes it through covers. A single is taken.
Fuller delivery outside off, Vijay shoulders his arms to it.
Short outside off, Vijay stands tall and pushes it towards the fielder at point.
WIDE! Way way outside off, left alone by Vijay. The umpire has signalled that as a wide.
Angling into the stumps, Vijay stays in his crease and pushes it from the inner half of the bat towards the fielder at mid on.
Full and wide outside off, Vijay leans into it and drives it straight towards the fielder at point who makes a fine stop to save it going for a boundary.
The players are out in the middle for the post-lunch session. Murali Vijay and Lokesh Rahul will continue batting for India while Taskin Ahmed will begin the proceedings with the ball for Bangladesh.
.... DAY 4, SESSION 2 ....

Fairly good morning for India although Bangladesh did resist with Rahim shepherding the lower order. The hosts finally managed to wrap up things with the lunch break not far away. India would ideally want to bat a session and perhaps a little more after tea before the declaration. Time will be a key factor and Bangladesh will want to prevent the Indians from scoring quickly as the visitors look to save the game. Join us in a while for the second session.
Fuller around off, Rahul leans into it and defends it solidly on to the track. LUNCH ON DAY 4.
Fuller on middle, worked past mid-wicket for a single. India are away and the lead is 300.
Pushed through quicker outside off, Vijay looks to cut but the ball keeps low, forcing a bottom edge on the bounce to first slip.
Fired in around off, hangs back and whips it towards mid on.
Darted outside off, sits on the back foot and pushes it towards extra cover.
Flatter outside off, defended well off the back foot to the off side.
